strings.formation.dc_pair: At least two natural central-defence slots protect the middle.
strings.formation.dc_pair_missing: This shape does not provide the minimum resilient central-defence base.
strings.formation.dmc_screen: A DMC gives the plan a natural screen in front of the centre-backs.
strings.formation.central_presence: Enough natural central-midfield presence keeps the shape connected without asking one player to cover several zones.
strings.formation.two_sided_progression: Both left and right attacking routes are naturally available.
strings.formation.no_forward_outlet: The shape lacks a natural forward outlet and does not have enough advanced scorers to compensate.
strings.tactic.short_support: The selected XI has enough close central support for short combinations.
strings.tactic.short_buildup: Short passing and Focus on Buildup reinforce the same possession route.
strings.tactic.long_counter: Long passing complements a deliberate counter-attacking route.
strings.tactic.long_no_outlet: Long passing has no convincing aerial/direct receiving outlet in this XI.
strings.tactic.left_no_players: Left focus is penalised because the XI has no natural left progression route.
strings.tactic.right_no_players: Right focus is penalised because the XI has no natural right progression route.
strings.tactic.both_incomplete_width: Both Flanks is penalised because one side lacks a natural progression route.
strings.tactic.high_cross_target_man: A Target Man plus an aerial outlet gives high crossing a clear receiving purpose.
strings.tactic.cross_winger: A Winger gives regular crossing a natural source.
strings.tactic.high_cross_winger: Winger service plus an aerial outlet can justify a higher crossing tendency.
strings.tactic.high_cross_no_target: High crossing is penalised because the XI lacks a convincing aerial target.
strings.tactic.counter_outlet: The XI contains the speed/directness needed to turn recoveries into attacks.
strings.tactic.regroup_lowblock: Regroup and Low Block protect the same defensive shape.
strings.tactic.counterpress_highpress: Counter Press and High Press reinforce the same aggressive recovery idea.
strings.tactic.counterpress_capacity: The XI has enough physical/defensive capacity to support immediate ball recovery.
strings.tactic.offside_highpress: An offside line is coherent with a higher press because the defensive line is already being asked to step up.
strings.tactic.offside_sweeper: A Sweeper Keeper gives extra semantic support to an aggressive defensive line.
strings.tactic.offside_lowblock_contradiction: Low Block and Offside Trap ask the defensive line to do contradictory things.
strings.tactic.track_lowblock: Tracking runners is coherent with a deeper/regrouping defensive plan.
strings.tactic.balanced_tackling_default: Balanced tackling is the neutral default when there is no strong reason to accept more risk.
strings.tactic.aggressive_disruptors: Ball-winning/stopper personnel gives a more aggressive tackling plan additional support.
strings.tactic.shoot_on_sight_shadow: Shadow Striker gives Shoot On Sight a direct Special Ability compatibility signal.
strings.tactic.work_box_finishers: The XI is stronger at close-range finishing than long-range shooting, supporting patient chance creation.
strings.tactic.shoot_on_sight_threat: The XI carries a stronger long-shot threat than close-range finishing advantage.
strings.mentor.locked_family: {mentor}: {family} boost is locked until Level {level}; it contributes 0.
strings.mentor.herrera.tactical: Force Counter Attack directly activates Herrera’s Tactical-family relevance.
strings.mentor.herrera.attribute: Creativity/Passing boosts are valued by how much the selected XI and plan actually use those white skills.
strings.mentor.herrera.signature: Blind Side only receives Signature credit when the selected plan deliberately forces counters.
strings.mentor.green.tactical: A wing-focused plan directly matches Green’s Wing Attack boost.
strings.mentor.green.attribute: Crossing/Heading value rises when the XI contains real crossers and aerial targets.
strings.mentor.green.signature: Aerial Dominance receives full context only when crosses are intentional and an aerial outlet exists.
strings.mentor.braun.tactical: Long passing directly matches Braun’s Tactical boost.
strings.mentor.braun.attribute: Strength/Positioning value is measured against the selected XI rather than assumed universally useful.
strings.mentor.braun.signature: Adaptive Blueprint depends on halftime observation; this pre-match own-squad optimiser gives it zero Signature credit.
strings.mentor.cesc.tactical: Short passing directly matches Fàbregas’s Tactical boost.
strings.mentor.cesc.attribute: Dribbling/Shooting value is measured against the selected XI and attacking route.
strings.mentor.cesc.signature: Momentum Chain fits sustained short-pass buildup once the Signature is unlocked.
strings.mentor.cesc.stamina_tradeoff: Momentum Chain has an extra midfielder Stamina cost, so low-drain plans reduce its net companion score.
strings.mentor.shearer.tactical: Shearer’s Tactical boost is relevant only to plans that genuinely rely on dribbling actions.
strings.mentor.shearer.attribute: Strength/Shooting value is measured against the players who can use those attributes in this XI.
strings.mentor.shearer.signature: Ankle Breaker depends on event context not available to this pre-match own-squad optimiser, so it receives zero Signature credit.
strings.mentor.vidic.tactical: Vidić gains value when the plan expects a high volume/importance of defensive actions.
strings.mentor.vidic.attribute: Tackling/Bravery value is strongest when defensive players in the XI actually carry those as white skills.
strings.mentor.vidic.signature: Iron Check gains own-plan context when the selected tactic deliberately creates high defensive-action demand.
strings.mentor.vidic.condition_tradeoff: Vidić’s Tactical family increases Condition/Stamina cost, reducing value when the drain budget is tight.
strings.mentor.vidic.card_tradeoff: Iron Check carries extra card risk; the recommendation must show the downside rather than only the benefit.
strings.mentor.makelele.tactical: Makélélé’s Tactical effect identity is known, but its activation depends on external passing context this app never collects; it receives zero pre-match ranking credit.
strings.mentor.makelele.attribute: Bravery/Positioning value is measured against current XI white-skill coverage and plan demand.
strings.mentor.makelele.signature: Parking the Bus is a live-state effect; this pre-match own-squad optimiser gives it zero ranking credit.
strings.mentor.makelele.attack_tradeoff: Parking the Bus reduces team Attacking attributes while active, so the defensive gain is not free.
strings.training.role: {skill} is a {tier}-tier development priority for the selected {role} role.
strings.training.playstyle: {playstyle} sets {skill} to {tier} for the selected {role} role.
strings.training.tactic.short: The active short-passing plan adds a small development bias to technical combination skills.
strings.training.tactic.long_passer: The active long-passing plan adds a small bias to distribution from deeper roles.
strings.training.tactic.long_outlet: The active long-passing plan adds a small bias to receiving/direct-outlet attributes.
strings.training.tactic.flank_carrier: The active flank plan adds a small bias to wide progression and delivery skills.
strings.training.tactic.flank_target: Regular crossing adds a small bias to aerial/box-target skills.
strings.training.tactic.center: Central focus adds a small bias to combination and final-third central skills.
strings.training.tactic.counter: Counterattacking adds a small bias to transition speed, carrying and finishing skills.
strings.training.tactic.highpress: High pressing adds a small bias to the physical/defensive skills used to sustain pressure.
strings.training.tactic.lowblock: Low Block adds a small bias to compact defending and aerial protection skills.
strings.training.grey_zero: {skill} is grey for this player’s current role union, so it receives zero training utility.
strings.training.secondary_white: {skill} is trainable because a secondary natural role makes it white, but the selected development role remains the main hierarchy.
strings.coverage.missing: No unique player can currently fill {slot} naturally.
strings.coverage.weak: {slot} is covered, but its best current natural option is materially below the first-XI quality level.
strings.coverage.versatile: {player} covers multiple useful roles, improving formation flexibility without counting twice in the starting blueprint.
strings.tactic.hard_attacking_thin_restdef: Hard Attacking is penalised because too few players remain in the defensive/rest-defence structure.
strings.tactic.mixed_passing_neutral: Short-combination and direct support are similarly convincing, so Mixed passing is the neutral fallback.
strings.tactic.buildup_short_coherence: Focus on Buildup reinforces the selected short-passing route.
strings.tactic.counter_direct_coherence: The selected direct/mixed passing route and a real transition outlet support Force Counter Attack.
strings.tactic.counter_no_outlet: Force Counter Attack is penalised because the XI lacks a convincing first transition runner/receiver.
strings.tactic.buildup_low_technical: Focus on Buildup is penalised because this XI is weak in the technical combination cluster.
strings.tactic.center_no_creator: Central focus is penalised because there is no AMC and too little natural central support to sustain the route.
strings.tactic.balanced_focus_neutral: Balanced focus is the neutral fallback; the optimiser does not invent a weak side to target.
strings.tactic.medium_cross_neutral: With no clear aerial-specialist reason to choose an extreme, Medium crossing is the neutral fallback.
strings.tactic.high_cross_no_width: High crossing is penalised because the XI has no natural wide progression source to deliver it consistently.
strings.tactic.regroup_low_capacity: A low pressing-capacity XI is better protected by regrouping than by repeatedly chasing immediate recoveries.
strings.tactic.counterpress_low_capacity: Counter Press is penalised because the XI lacks the physical/defensive capacity to sustain it.
strings.tactic.highpress_low_capacity: High Press is penalised because this XI lacks the physical/defensive capacity to sustain it.
strings.tactic.offside_slow_line: Offside Trap is penalised because the defensive line lacks enough speed/positioning support for an aggressive line.
strings.tactic.track_neutral: Tracking opponents is the conservative default when the evidence does not justify an offside line.
strings.tactic.man_low_capacity: Man-to-man marking is penalised because the available markers are weak in the marking/speed/strength cluster.
strings.tactic.balanced_shooting_neutral: Box finishing and long-shot threat are similar, so Balanced shooting avoids forcing one chance type.
strings.tactic.box_short_combinations: Short combinations and sufficient central support make Work It Into The Box more coherent.
strings.training.tactic.buildup: Focus on Buildup adds a small long-term bias to the technical/positional skills used to connect phases.
strings.training.tactic.counterpress: Counter Press adds a small bias to the fitness, speed and defensive aggression needed for immediate recovery.
strings.training.tactic.regroup: Regroup adds a small bias to positioning, marking and the physical skills used to restore compact shape.
strings.training.tactic.offside: An offside-line identity adds a small bias to positioning, speed and goalkeeper/defensive-line coordination skills.
strings.training.tactic.manmark: Man-to-man marking adds a small bias to marking, speed, strength and positioning for defensive roles.
strings.training.tactic.zonal: Zonal marking adds a small bias to positioning, marking and communication/concentration skills.
strings.training.tactic.aggressive: Aggressive tackling adds a small bias to tackling, bravery, aggression and strength.
strings.training.tactic.stay: Stay On Feet adds a small bias to positioning, marking and recovery speed rather than extra aggression.
strings.training.tactic.box: Work It Into The Box adds a small bias to combination play, close finishing and attacking positioning.
strings.training.tactic.sight: Shoot On Sight adds a small bias to Shooting and the creativity needed to create shooting windows.
strings.training.tactic.highcross: High crossing adds a small bias to delivery plus aerial receiving/finishing skills.
strings.training.tactic.lowcross: Low crossing adds a small bias to delivery, speed, carrying and close-range finishing skills.
strings.coverage.missing_flexibility: The starting blueprint is covered, but the squad is missing {slot}, reducing the formations you can switch to naturally.
strings.coverage.missing_depth: The tactical blueprint is covered, but the squad lacks {slot} as availability/rotation protection.
strings.coverage.profile_upgrade: {slot} is covered, but a player with the suggested multi-role profile would improve flexibility without replacing two separate starters.
strings.mentor.unavailable: {mentor} has no saved usable level, so the optimiser treats this Mentor as unavailable.
strings.mentor.unlocked_family: {mentor}: {family} is unlocked at Level {level} and may contribute only when its context matches.
strings.mentor.next_unlock: {mentor}: the next family unlock is {family} at Level {level}; its hypothetical value is shown separately and never added to the current score.
strings.mentor.prestige_state: Prestige strengthens the real Signature state, but the optimiser does not invent extra points unless the actual effect values are known.
strings.training.gap_critical: {skill} is a critical relative development gap inside this player’s current role/Playstyle hierarchy.
strings.training.gap_high: {skill} is a high relative development gap for this player.
strings.training.gap_maintenance: {skill} is comparatively developed already, so it receives maintenance priority rather than dominating the session.
strings.formation.two_sided_defence: Natural defenders cover both wide defensive lanes.
strings.formation.rest_defence: The shape keeps a strong defensive/rest-defence base behind its attacking routes.
strings.formation.rest_defence_thin: Too few natural defensive/screening roles remain behind the attacking structure.
strings.formation.central_creator: A natural AMC gives the XI a dedicated central connection into the final third.
strings.formation.advanced_threats: The shape contains several natural advanced scoring/creation slots without inventing a matchup weakness.
strings.tactic.mentality_neutral: Normal mentality is the neutral own-squad starting point when no structural reason justifies an extreme.
strings.tactic.attacking_supported: The XI has enough advanced threat and rest defence to support an Attacking starting mentality.
strings.tactic.defending_transition: A strong rest-defence base plus a real transition outlet gives Defending mentality a coherent own-squad route forward.
strings.tactic.hard_attacking_supported: A very attack-heavy XI can support Hard Attacking only when enough rest defence and pressing capacity remain.
strings.tactic.hard_defending_prematch: Hard Defending is an extreme pre-match commitment; without live context the optimiser applies a small caution penalty.
strings.tactic.long_outlet: Long passing has a credible direct, aerial or transition receiver in this XI.
strings.tactic.center_supported: Central focus is supported by a natural AMC or strong close central support.
strings.tactic.both_supported: Both Flanks is supported because the XI has natural progression routes on both sides.
strings.tactic.left_supported: Left focus is supported because the XI has a left progression route and no equivalent right-side route.
strings.tactic.right_supported: Right focus is supported because the XI has a right progression route and no equivalent left-side route.
strings.tactic.high_cross_expert: Cross Expert adds semantic support to higher crossing when the XI also has a natural delivery lane.
strings.tactic.lowpress_capacity: Low Press receives structural support when the XI has limited pressing capacity.
strings.tactic.midpress_capacity: Mid Press fits an XI with medium pressing capacity without forcing an extreme.
strings.tactic.highpress_capacity: High Press receives structural support when the XI has high physical/defensive pressing capacity.
strings.tactic.offside_fast_line: A fast, well-positioned defensive line gives extra own-squad support to an offside line.
strings.tactic.zonal_neutral: Marking effectiveness depends on external attack context that this app will not collect; Zonal is used only as a lower-drain neutral fallback.
strings.tactic.man_capacity: High marker capacity makes Man-to-Man structurally feasible, without claiming it is better against any unseen attack.
strings.tactic.stay_control: Stay On Feet receives own-squad support when the defensive line/markers are less suited to aggressive individual contests.
strings.training.target_shape: {skill} has a {tier}-tier Role+Playstyle target ratio, so its desired level is intentionally shaped relative to this player’s other white skills.
strings.training.target_gap: {skill} is {gap} points below its current Role+Playstyle shape target and receives development priority.
strings.training.target_met: {skill} is already at or above its current Role+Playstyle shape target, so it receives maintenance rather than catch-up priority.
strings.setpiece.captain_companion: Captaincy has no proven gameplay effect. Top Eleven Tool defaults to the highest-OVR starter for convenience; Captain is excluded from Team Plan scoring and any starter may be chosen manually.
strings.setpiece.specialist: {player} receives first consideration for {slot} because the relevant set-piece Special Ability is present.
strings.setpiece.skill: {player} ranks strongly for {slot} from the relevant visible set-piece skills in this XI.
strings.training.intensity_gain: Harder regular drills carry more verified base XP: Very Easy 1, Easy 2, Medium 3, Hard 4, Very Hard 5 per player before drill-level effect.
